reply_text:
Bettina, the official handoff of Pellucid Harbor Logistics to Kwame was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Sun 11/2 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own Dec 8 cutover recap also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.

Your recap adds that you kept running PHL day to day through Nov 21 for the terminal cutover. Kwame fully took over operationally on Nov 22. If the tracker needs the actual start of Kwame's day-to-day coverage, use Nov 22. For the official ownership change, use Nov 3.
